description: Power BI connector (read-only). Indexes Power BI reports as `powerbi:dashboard` items in the local index and exposes three read-only tools to the Nimbus agent (`powerbi_list`, `powerbi_get`, `powerbi_search`). Uses Azure AD client-credentials flow (tenant_id/client_id/client_secret) to mint an access token, then calls the Power BI REST API. Hosts are fixed well-known endpoints (login.microsoftonline.com for AAD tokens, api.powerbi.com for the API); the static manifest network list declares both hosts directly — no per-tenant host derivation is needed. No write tools.
author: Nimbus
